changelog: Kapitel-I-Runde: 7 Basis-Records (c1_*): nature closed, sense-awareness, homogeneous/heterogeneous thought, fact/factors/entities, event, situation, substratum critique
Varianten-Mechanik beschlossen: Konservativ (1 Record) vs. Dreigliedrig (3 Detail-Records) via part_of_variant_of
Kapitel-II-Runde: 5 Records (c2_*): bifurcation-These, apparent/causal nature, rescue attempts, psychological addition, fire problem
Kapitel-III-Runde: 6 Records (c3_*): duration, simultaneity vs. instantaneousness, passage of nature, abstractive set, moment, materialistic trinity gap
Kapitel-IV-Runde: 6 Records (c4_*): simple location rationale, ideal simplicity/intrinsic character, abstractive set (erweitert), covering/equality, abstractive element, event-particle/punct

Kapitel-V-Runde: 7 Records (c5_*): percipient event/cogredience, here/station, timeless vs. instantaneous space, motion/rest frame-relative, vagrant/durate solids, rectilinear routes, perpendicularity
Kapitel-VI-Runde: 6 Records (c6_*): Kongruenz-Messtheorie, Poincare/Russell + recognition, sechs Axiome, kinetische Symmetrie, New-theory-Vorteile, Konventionalismus
Kapitel-VII-Runde: 7 Records (c7_*): objects do not pass, ingression, object types, blue-ingression classes, active/passive conditioning, perceptual objects, scientific objects

Doppelrunde Kapitel VIII+IX: 11 Records (c8_*/c9_*): conclude/reconstruct, Cleopatra-Criterion, critical determinations, field/potential, ethos of softening, activity/passage, significance, stratification, congruence from cogredience, light egalitarianism, Einstein dialog
UI-Flag var_expandable: True nur bei c1_substratum_critique und c8_ethos_of_softening
Artefakt-Scrubs mit Assertions (CJK, Garble) mehrfach angewendet; Changelog-Historie dokumentiert alle Korrekturzyklen
